Additionally, the pose auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk level (73% low-confidence keypoints), indicating widespread anatomical uncertainty in the generated limbs and faces. While the overall lighting and texture are high quality, these specific structural failures in the primary action (holding umbrellas) reduce authenticity.
